pendentes.titulo: Como testar a bateria do notebook pelo próprio Windows, sem instalar nada
pendentes.alt: Notebook preto fechado sobre uma bancada de madeira, com a bateria removível e o carregador ao lado
pendentes.pedido: A closed black plastic laptop with a thick bezel lying on a clean wooden workbench, seen from a three-quarter angle. Next to it rests a rectangular laptop battery pack and a coiled power adapter with its cable. A small screwdriver lies slightly out of focus in the background. Soft daylight coming from a window on the left, shallow depth of field, calm and tidy workspace.
